The HTML duplicates the content of page 2 by including images that represent the entire flyer alongside the extracted text. The alt text of the images explicitly states they contain the text content (such as the list of app features, account balance, and transaction history), while the exact same content is extracted and displayed as HTML text right below them. This causes screen reader and sighted users (if images render) to experience the content twice.
